name: GodHandAndroid

project.name: God Hand Android Port (PS2 static recompilation, PCSX2 GS renderer)
project.license: GPL-3.0 (upstream LasVola/godhand-recomp); Android repo lists none

assets.needs: God Hand USA disc (SLUS-215.03) as an ISO, picked in the launcher; it is extracted and indexed into the app's cache (SLUS_215.03, GODHAND.AFS/_DATA.AFS, MODULES/IRX.IMS).
assets.location: Picked via SAF, extracted to /data/data/com.owaissseeee.godhand/files/godhand_cache. Fallback: an already-extracted folder at /sdcard/Download/God Hand (USA)/.

settings.in_app_menu: Launcher main screen settings (GRAPHICS / CONTROLS / AUDIO & SYSTEM tabs) and the in-game settings dialog. Renderer, resolution, aspect and FPS are locked while a game is running.
settings.summary: Renderer (Vulkan PCSX2-GS recommended, OpenGL ES 3.2, native GLES), resolution 0.5x-8x (default 1x native 512x448), aspect 16:9/4:3/full, 30 or 60 FPS (60 marked buggy), frameskip, audio scheduling/buffer, controller mode, dodge mode, touch opacity, FPS overlay.

controls: Auto-detects a physical gamepad (or force touch-only/gamepad-only); touch overlay auto-hides with a pad. Custom touch button layout stored in the same prefs. Dodge on right stick, swipe, or 4 dodge buttons.
display: Single screen (no secondary-display code in the APK).
saves: PS2 memory card Mcd001.ps2 (and Mcd002.ps2) plus save states under /data/data/com.owaissseeee.godhand/files (exact sub-folder not confirmed).
notes: The checked build reports versionName 1.0.0-godhand-recomp, which does not say which release it is. GitHub releases are tagged Beta (2026-10-25), release/v2.1 (2026-11-21, app-release-v2.1.apk) and v2.2 (2026-11-22).
verified: On device: dumpsys, data dir. APK: SettingsRepository (prefs file, keys, defaults, ranges), SettingsDialog/MainActivity labels, IsoCacheProcessor paths, libgodhand_android.so strings. Web: GitHub repos and releases. Nothing tested in the running app.
